<module id="pulse_detect">
	<description>Implement pulse detect logic for input signal data_in.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
		<input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
		
		<output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
	end
	
	<implementation>
		// Declare a register variable 'state' to store the current state of the detector
		reg [2:0] state;
		
		// Define the states for the state machine
		localparam IDLE = 3'b000,
				   DATA_IN_LOW = 3'b001,
				   DATA_IN_HIGH = 3'b010,
				   DATA_IN_LOW_AGAIN = 3'b011,
				   PULSE_END = 3'b100;
				   
		// Always block triggered on the rising edge of clk or falling edge of rst_n
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(~rst_n) begin
				state <= IDLE; // Reset state to IDLE on active-low reset
				data_out <= 1'b0; // Set data_out to 0 during reset
			end else begin
				case(state)
					IDLE: begin
						if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
							state <= DATA_IN_LOW; // Transition to DATA_IN_LOW state if data_in is low
						end
					end
					
					DATA_IN_LOW: begin
						if(data_in == 1'b1) begin
							state <= DATA_IN_HIGH; // Transition to DATA_IN_HIGH state if data_in transitions from low to high
						end
					end
					
					DATA_IN_HIGH: begin
						if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
							state <= DATA_IN_LOW_AGAIN; // Transition to DATA_IN_LOW_AGAIN state if data_in transitions from high to low
						end
					end
					
					DATA_IN_LOW_AGAIN: begin
						if(data_in == 1'b0) begin
							state <= PULSE_END; // Transition to PULSE_END state if data_in remains low
						end
					end
					
					PULSE_END: begin
						state <= IDLE; // Transition back to IDLE state after pulse ends
					end
				
					default: begin
						state</implementation></ports></module>
